# FREQUENCIES

Frequency tables.

## Syntax

```text
FREQUENCIES [/]VARIABLES=varlist.
```

Other subcommands are not supported yet.

## Example

```text
FREQUENCIES VARIABLES=gender region.
```

`statscraft help FREQUENCIES` prints the same text in the terminal. [All commands](README.md)
